PROCESS CONTROL SHEET - FAB LINE 2, WEEK 31

Gate Oxide Growth

The gate oxide growth step targets a feature size of 12 nm for this technology node. Chamber pressure during oxidation is held at 150 mTorr to control film uniformity across the wafer. First-pass yield for the gate oxide growth step was measured at 98.72% over the current run.

Polysilicon Deposition

The polysilicon deposition step is specified for a feature size of 45 nm at the gate stack. Chamber pressure for polysilicon deposition is maintained at 240 Pa throughout the deposition cycle. The silane-to-nitrogen gas flow ratio for polysilicon deposition is set to 3:1. Yield for the polysilicon deposition step came in at 97.05% for this lot.

Boron Implant

Post-anneal dopant concentration for the boron implant is 1.2e17 atoms/cm3, measured by SIMS at mid-depth. The iron impurity limit for the boron implant is 5 ppb, per the incoming wafer specification.

Phosphorus Implant

Post-anneal dopant concentration for the phosphorus implant is 5 x 10^15 atoms/cm3, per the SIMS profile. The carbon impurity limit for the phosphorus implant is 10 ppm under the current recipe. The arsine-to-hydrogen gas flow ratio for the phosphorus implant is 1:4.

Metal Etch

Under the standard recipe, chamber pressure for the metal etch step is held at 80 mTorr. Under the high-density recipe, chamber pressure for the metal etch step is reduced to 25 mTorr for improved anisotropy. Yield for the metal etch step was 99.10% across the batch.

Wafer Lot 7742

Wafer lot 7742 is processed on 300 mm (12-inch) substrates per the standard flow for this line.
